items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I'd like to send the manuscript to you and have Stanley have a look at it.

ctx.x: And from that, I got an offer in Ireland and I had one published there about a year and a half ago, about a year ago, and now I have just finished. -- there are just short books of anecdotes and vignettes. The last one will be about 70 pages and I am hoping to have that published here in London.
And -- but again, I'd be interested in what you said earlier, I'd like to send the manuscript to you and have Stanley have a look at it.
Well, as you said, there is a great market for the life that musicians lead, you know, there's a tremendous interest in it.
